notes.title: First big game update
notes.content:
[h1][b]New levels[/b][/h1]

Several new levels have been added. With new objects. And puzzles based on them.

[h1][b]Conveyors[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33866448/fabd34f3732fd2d4475b53bb48a68f467e727c89.gif[/img]

We've added a new object conveyor. He can move boxes, balls, barrels, as well as the main character. Now in the level editor you can create endless conveyor belts.

[h1][b]Laser Mirror[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33866448/5ff71a0d2efa9b61e4abcfa607c5c4e9f65af658.gif[/img]

Now the laser beam is reflected from the new mirror object. You can make tangled chains of mirrors and lasers. Which makes the puzzles even more interesting.

[h1][b]Level icons in the menu have become larger.[/b][/h1]
Now, when you save the level, a screenshot of the level is created based on the position of the main camera. Thus, you can make a screenshot of your level whiter presentable.
